_evidence: Globals of 0x46b580 (closes a file opened by 0x46b4a0 with fopen(name, "rb")): 0x46b580 tests [0xa03a18] (the FILE* stored by 0x46b4a0 at 0x46b504 from fopen 0x5dc713), null = nothing to do; else clears 0xa05c28, calls fclose 0x5dc52c (excluded CRT, called at its original address by the reconstruction too), clears 0xa03a18 and HeapFree's [0xa03a20] (the buffer HeapAlloc'd at 0x46b53a; the HeapFree model accepts any pointer, so the fuzz value is fine). The FILE is null in about a quarter of the cases, else iostrg_0046b580 (_IOSTRG set, so fclose returns without the CRT lock imports, which are unmodelled and would end every case external). Compose as globals=fuzz:i32+layout=file_0046b580.
